name: mockspeed
description: Draws grey mocks of websites and apps, live in the chat, while you talk an idea over.

interface.longDescription: mockspeed draws a grey mock of the website or app you're talking over, right in the chat, while you talk. Say what you have in mind — "a site for Ferment, a sourdough club: classes, a schedule, sign up" — and the pages appear in a few seconds, using the names, prices and times from your conversation instead of placeholder text. Then keep talking: "what if those were cards", "put the prices under the names", "add a page for the starter swap". Each change is drawn as it's said. You can also click the mock and change it yourself in the panel. Every mock is kept in your mockspeed account, where you can open it in a browser and export it. Mocks are rough grey sketches for thinking an idea through, not finished designs.
defaultPrompt: I'm starting a sourdough club called Ferment, classes Saturdays at £25. Sketch the site.
Mock up a booking app for my barber shop: services, a calendar, a confirmation screen.
What would a landing page for my newsletter look like?
capabilities: Draw mocks of sites and apps

positive.description: Start a mock from the conversation
positive.prompt: Sketch a site for Ferment, a sourdough club: classes, schedule, sign up
positive.expected_behavior: A 3-4 page grey mock titled Ferment draws in the panel.

positive.prompt: What if the classes were cards?
positive.expected_behavior: The class list is redrawn as cards.

positive.prompt: Add a page for the starter swap
positive.expected_behavior: A new page for the starter swap appears.
The last change is taken back.

positive.description: See the mock as it is
positive.expected_behavior: Its pages and elements are listed and the mock is shown again.

negative.prompt: Write me a CSS file for a navbar
